async def act(page):
    # Search for 'Super_Awesome_Robot' using the search box
    search_box = page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Filter by name')
    await search_box.fill('Super_Awesome_Robot')
    await search_box.press('Enter')
    # Wait for the page to update after search
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Click on the project link to navigate to its details page
    # Use exact matching for the project name to ensure accuracy
    project_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Super_Awesome_Robot', exact=True)
    await project_link.click()
    # Wait for the project details page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
